prompt: An operator wrote this runbook to patch the operating system on node 3 and return it to service. Which line is the mistake?
explanation: Maintenance mode is designed exactly for OS patching: entering it migrates the shards out, records a snapshot of the node's shard and endpoint configuration, and marks the node so no shards return to it. When the patching is done, `maintenance_mode off` restores the node from that snapshot. Removing the node is wrong — removal permanently decreases cluster capacity, and a removed node must have Redis Software uninstalled and reinstalled before it can ever rejoin.
codeLines: # Patch the OS on node 3 during a maintenance window
rladmin node 3 remove   # free the drained node so it can be patched
